root_cause.text: The function scarlett2_usb_get_config() incorrectly used the total buffer size in bytes to determine endianness conversion, causing a loop to read beyond the allocated buffer when the element count is greater than one because it treated the entire buffer as a single element type rather than respecting the actual element size.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The code checks `if (size == 2)` where `size` is the total buffer size in bytes, then loops `count` times treating each element as u16 (2 bytes). This causes the loop to access `count * 2` bytes when the buffer only has `size` bytes allocated." The patch changes the condition to check `config_item->size == 16` (and `== 32`) instead of `size == 2` (and `== 4`).
